'''2007 Ohio State Championship Michael Pistone DS Endor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' You Don't Really Wanna AKA Tanks 4 Coming!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
